name: Blood Rituals heals a marked ally when Bloodmoon Blast is cast (#6401)
contract: #6401: Bloodmoon Blast must heal the ally the Bloodmage actually marked. #5934 gated that heal on aura 706624 ('Blood Rituals'), which no character on this client set can hold: it is not a rank spell of any CharacterAdvancement.dbc entry (its Sanguine neighbours 705731/705732/705733 are entries 33706/33704/33707 there), it has no SkillLineAbility row, and it appears in neither the client's talent-tree table (SpellbookTreeSpellData.h), the trainer offers (SpellbookOfferData.h), AscensionSpellProgressionData nor playercreateinfo_spell_custom - its only in-client mention is Dark Liturgy's tooltip reference @s:706624:0@. The record that carries the current Sanguine talent text, 705729 ('Dark Liturgy now marks allies for $706623d and Bloodmoon Blast now heals marked allies for ${$704119m1+$SP*0.07+$STA*0.085}'), has a single SkillLineAbility row (91377, SkillLine 73, AcquireMethod 0) and Player::learnSkillRewardedSpells grants only AcquireMethod 1/2, so it is unlearnable too, and it is not a catalog rank spell either. The #5934 gate therefore read an aura nobody can acquire, so casting Bloodmoon Blast healed no one at all. The contract that is reachable is the mark's own: 706623's tooltip is 'Healed whenever the Bloodmage uses Bloodmoon Blast. Lasts $d.' (SpellDuration 18 = 20 s) and Dark Liturgy rank 1 (501623, level 20, class-20 chain 800781) applies that mark natively through its own EffectTriggerSpell, bouncing to up to 10 allies. 704119 is the heal (SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, TargetA 22 TARGET_SRC_CASTER + TargetB 30 TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ALLY, RadiusIndex 27, EffectBasePoints 3 / DieSides 1 / RealPointsPerLevel 3.7, MaxAffectedTargets 25) and its spell_ascension_blood_rituals_heal target-select script still narrows the area down to 706623 carriers, the same shape Dark Essence's 681036 selector uses. This scenario pins that contract: the marked ally is healed exactly once per cast with no Blood Rituals aura learned, the unmarked ally is never healed, and learning either legacy aura (706624, the #5934 id, or 705729, the live-text id) adds no second heal per cast - the counters are cumulative and exact, so any overshoot fails. The install tooltip's $SP*0.07/$STA*0.085 bonus-healing terms remain a separate tooltip-parity question (no spell_bonus_data row backs them) and are not asserted. 572332 is the Bloodmoon Blast rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h's 500125 chain.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Blood Rituals mark on one ally only
Bloodmoon Blast with no Blood Rituals aura
The marked ally is healed without any Blood Rituals aura
An ally without the Blood Rituals mark is not healed
Refresh the mark before the second cast
Clear the global cooldown from the first cast
Bloodmoon Blast with the legacy 706624 aura
The legacy #5934 aura adds no second heal
Refresh the mark before the third cast
Clear the global cooldown from the second cast
Bloodmoon Blast with the live-text 705729 aura
One heal per cast with the live-text aura as well
The unmarked ally still stays unhealed
